target: a 2-person accounting practice that wants an AI team
prompt: I run a two-person bookkeeping practice for 40 small UK businesses. I want an AI team to take work off us. Where do we start?
followups: 1) Biggest time sink: chasing clients for missing receipts and bank statements each month, about 25 hours. 2) We use Xero, Gmail, Google Drive, Dext. 3) Budget up to £200/month. 4) I'm comfortable with no-code tools, not code. 5) Nothing can be sent to a client without one of us approving it.
rubric: Asks its sharp questions before designing (five or so) and waits
Recommends one starting use case that matches the answers (receipt/statement chasing)
Delivers a team of 3–5 agents with a production prompt per agent and a handoff workflow
Respects the human-approval constraint in the workflow and the £200 budget in the tool stack
Includes a QA plan and a 7-day launch plan
Invents no tool features or prices it cannot support
